subject: No plot when texts along the x axis (written vertically for convenience) are too long

messages.author: c6f4123be4a725e9
messages.subject: No plot when texts along the x axis (written vertically for convenience) are too long
parts:
Hi everyone,

it seems that when axis x text lenghts are too big the plot which represents the corresponding histogram or barplot just vanishes.
Is there some solution to get a histogram or barplot with long texts along the x axis ?

Thanks for help.

Alain
